name: io.github.docsagent/zotero
description: MCP server that lets AI agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, Qwen Code) search, read, and write a local Zotero library through a resident native C++ search engine. Full-text BM25 search, query-ranked passage retrieval, metadata/citations, and gated write tools (import by DOI/arXiv, notes, batch modify) — all local-first: the library never leaves the machine.
